features.title: Everything a ruler needs
f1.d: Take the throne of one of twenty-one kingdoms, from Rome-like Aeteren and Carthage-like Qart-Hadas to the Goths of Gautagard.
f2.d: Command your troops in real time. Storm city walls, starve out a fortress or fight it out ship against ship.
f3.d: Forge alliances, make enemies and uncover plots at court. When the crown passes on, the succession can change everything.
f4.d: Every general has tactics, courage, cunning and charisma. Who you put in command shapes every battle.
f5.d: Rival kingdoms play by exactly the same rules as you. No hidden bonuses, no shortcuts: every victory earned.
f6.d: No connection needed. Play on the train, on a plane or on the beach.
f7.d: Play in your own language, with thirteen to choose from.
f8.d: Royal Edition removes ads and unlocks extras at once; free players can earn the same extras by watching ads.
cultures.title: Choose your people
cultures.sub: Each culture fights, trades and rules in its own way, inspired by the peoples of the ancient world. Here they are as they look in battle.
world.title: From the Azure Gulf to the Ocean of Winds
world.sub: Two great continents, scattered islands and the seas between them. Every city on the map can be taken, and every one can be lost.

royal.title: Your king, in royal style
royal.line: One-time purchase: no ads, all 21 kingdoms unlocked, unlimited saves, replays and top speed, +30 trait points for your king in each new world, and royal looks for every army, general and king. Battles play exactly the same for everyone, and free players can earn the same extras one ad at a time.
